name: Sahel insurgency
summary: JNIM's blockade of Bamako continues; Mali relies on escorted fuel convoys
state: JNIM's fuel blockade of Mali's capital, imposed in September 2025 and declared total on 28 Apr 2026, was last reported in force with Bamako relying on escorted convoys; no report of it being lifted had been found as of 2 Nov. Mali air strikes reportedly killed 89 civilians on 19 Oct, and analysts warn JNIM's blockade tactics threaten West African trade corridors.
for_you: Follow FCDO advice against all travel to most of Mali, Burkina Faso and Niger.

why: Jihadist groups control growing territory across Mali, Burkina Faso and Niger, driving displacement and coastal-state spillover.
drivers: JNIM/IS-Sahel offensives, juntas, Russian forces, blockades, coastal-state attacks.
